$doc: Vyomi capability registry — SQS. One entry per console feature; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI.

sqs.queue.attributes.title: Queue configuration (visibility timeout, retention, delay, max size, wait time, encryption, access policy)

sqs.messages.send-receive.title: Send, receive, delete and purge messages

sqs.queue.fifo.title: FIFO queues (message group ordering, content-based + explicit deduplication)

sqs.dlq.redrive-task.title: Dead-letter queue redrive tasks (StartMessageMoveTask)
limitations: A redrive task runs to completion immediately (moving every available message) instead of a real, rate-limited background task — Status is always COMPLETED, so there is no RUNNING task to track progress on or cancel with CancelMessageMoveTask, and MaxNumberOfMessagesPerSecond is accepted but has no effect.

sqs.sns-subscriptions.title: SNS subscriptions (subscribe/unsubscribe this queue to an SNS topic)

sqs.lambda-triggers.title: Lambda triggers (event source mappings)
limitations: A message landing in the queue is invoked synchronously, one message per Lambda invocation, the instant SendMessage returns — not through a real batched, asynchronous poller. BatchSize / MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds are stored but have no effect on batching. The message is deleted from the queue only if the invocation succeeds (LastProcessingResult reflects the real outcome); a function error leaves it for redelivery, same as real SQS.

sqs.eventbridge-pipes.title: EventBridge Pipes (queue as a pipe source)
limitations: A message is forwarded to the pipe's Target the instant SendMessage returns, not through a real background poller. Enrichment and InputTemplate/filtering on the pipe are stored but not applied — the raw message body is forwarded as-is. The message is removed from the source queue only once delivery to a real target (an existing queue/topic/function/state machine/stream) succeeds.
